liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Smokin From Shootin** (1 review): This track was cited by the listener as one of their favorites [12]
- **Cobra** (1 review): The performance of this track is highlighted as a standout moment [7]
- **Steam Engine** (1 review): This performance was listed among the listener's favorite songs of the night [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Two Halves**: rare: 13 archived performances [18]
- **Look At You**: rare: 13 archived performances [18]
- **Where To Begin**: back after 67 archived shows (1029 days) [18]
- **Low Rider**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **Oye Como Va**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]

## The recordings

- **mmj2008-08-16.mk21.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 31 songs; 187 min; rated 4.82/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Initial tracks sound rough until sound engineers correct the mix levels for the SBD; Once levels are tweaked, the Porter Shoeps speakers provide excellent audio quality; The reviewer notes that the audio levels in the recording are low [6][8]
- **mmj2008-08-16.mk4v**: source not stated; 31 songs; 181 min [2]
- **mmj2008-08-16.km140.702**: source not stated; 29 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: This source is considered best, while others have bass that is a bit heavy; The track names in this recording are incorrect but easily fixable [14]
- **mmj2008-08-16.mk4.flac24**: source not stated; 29 songs; 181 min [3]

## Around the show

- The venue is described as a cool little location [7]
- The listener and husband drove from Atlanta, having planned the trip months in advance [12]
- The couple drove from Atlanta, having previously seen the band at the Roxy and Tabernacle [13]
- The audience member sat in the front row for the performance [17]
- Louisville Leopard Percussionists joined My Morning Jacket for the Low Rider and Oye Como Va segment [1]
- The listener anticipates upcoming shows at Boston's Bank of America Pavilion and MSG [11]
- The wife rated this as the best show she had ever seen [13]
- The show is compared to The Grateful Dead as the only comparable live experience [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2008-08-16.mk21.flac16**: taped by Brian Porter; source: Schoeps mk21 (NOS/FOB) > kc5 > cmc6xt > Oade m148 > Mytek 192 > Tascam HD-P2 (24/48) [1]
- **mmj2008-08-16.mk4v**: taped by Brent Stober; transferred by Brent Stober; source: FOB Schoeps mk4v > kc5 > cmc6 > Lunatec V2 > Apogee Mini-Me > Sound Device 702 @24/48 [2]. Also: The recording was transferred from a CDR to WAVE files with some technical problems noted [2]
- **mmj2008-08-16.km140.702**: taped by John Wilson; transferred by John Wilson; source: AK40>LC3>KM100>SD702>wav(24/48) [5]
- **mmj2008-08-16.mk4.flac24**: taped by Patrick Moore; transferred by Patrick Moore; source: Schoeps mk4 (ortf)> kc5> cmc6xt> Edirol R4 (24/48) [3]
